# BugsFixer Pakistan – IT Services, Infrastructure & Max Sale ERP Solutions

> BugsFixer is Pakistan's premier IT solutions company and hardware engineering center based in Peshawar. We engineer turn-key CCTV video surveillance, chip-level laptop motherboard repairs, biometric access control, Cat6/Fiber networking, PABX intercom exchanges, and custom Python-powered Max Sale ERP software.

BugsFixer operates an integrated IT engineering center servicing Peshawar, University Road, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, KPK, and providing software deployments nationwide across Pakistan.

## Primary Web Portals & Resources

- [BugsFixer Official Website](https://bugsfixerweb.pp.ua/): Main company portal, full IT service catalog, hardware vault, and custom bundle requisition builder.
- [Max Sale ERP Cloud Portal](https://bugsfixer.pp.ua/): Live cloud web analytics dashboard for Professional Plan multi-branch ERP clients.

## Core Technical Services Directory

- [CCTV & Video Surveillance](https://bugsfixerweb.pp.ua/cctv): Deployment of 4K IP PoE cameras, HD-TVI/CVI analog systems, PTZ sector cameras, Hikvision ColorVu full-color night vision, Dahua, UNV, and encrypted mobile app setup.
- [Laptop & PC Chip Repair](https://bugsfixerweb.pp.ua/laptopservices): Micro-soldering, BGA rework, GPU reballing, power delivery IC replacement, liquid damage recovery, NVMe SSD speed upgrades, and certified pre-owned Dell, HP, Lenovo, and MacBook laptops.
- [Biometric Access Control](https://bugsfixerweb.pp.ua/security): AI facial recognition terminals, optical fingerprint attendance devices, ZKTeco systems, 600lbs electromagnetic door locks, turnstile speed gates, and addressable fire alarms.
- [Networking & PABX Telephony](https://bugsfixerweb.pp.ua/telephone-networking): Structured Cat6 and multi-mode Fiber Optic cabling, Cisco switch routing, MikroTik RouterBoard VLAN configuration, Ubiquiti UniFi Wi-Fi mesh, and Grandstream IP-PBX exchanges.
- [Electronics Repair Services](https://bugsfixerweb.pp.ua/electronics): Component-level PCB troubleshooting for LED/LCD TV mainboards, commercial UPS power supplies, SMPS units, photo printers, and industrial PLC control panels.

## Max Sale ERP Software Plans

- [Max Sale Essential Plan](https://bugsfixerweb.pp.ua/build-bundle?software=essential): Standalone POS billing and stock inventory software for single-counter retail stores with perpetual lifetime licensing.
- [Max Sale Plus Plan](https://bugsfixerweb.pp.ua/build-bundle?software=plus): Custom Python Master-Terminal LAN server architecture connecting 1 Master PC with up to 10 Terminal PCs for real-time multi-counter syncing and daily email reports.
- [Max Sale Professional Plan](https://bugsfixerweb.pp.ua/build-bundle?software=professional): Full enterprise plan featuring Android/iOS Field Mobile App, live Web Dashboard access, multi-branch consolidated analytics, and annual SLA updates.
